name: gh-secrets
//: The published crate: lib gh_secrets + bin gh-secrets, with its inline unit tests. It is the root project, so it also owns every file no other project claims (scripts/, .github/, docs); its inputs are narrowed to what the crate compiles from so a docs edit replays cached lint/format results. It may depend only on type:app projects (tools/project-boundaries.json).

build.//: Produces target/debug/gh-secrets, the binary the e2e and live journeys spawn when they run uninstrumented (Windows, and the real live runs).

test.//: Unit tests under cargo-llvm-cov (--no-report): raw profiles land in target/llvm-cov-target for workspace:coverage to merge. Uncached: cargo-llvm-cov names every profile after the workspace, not the crate, so a replay would restore siblings' stale profiles.
